fee: Fees are shared when you enquire.

schedule.attendance: Each student attends five days a week, with one rotating weekday off, Sunday off.

classStructure.groupSize: Small groups with a guide who knows every student.
classStructure.dailyPracticeTest: Every class ends with a practice test on what was just taught.
classStructure.doubtClinics: Doubts are solved in a separate short session.

baseline.name: Entrance baseline for children
baseline.description: A short diagnostic on reasoning, reading and arithmetic; it places learners, it never excludes.
